corrected_value.title: Negative emotional eating patterns among American university students: A replication study.

decisions.location: Abstract (line 4), Publisher introduction preview (line 6), Publisher conclusions preview (line 8), and Reference list metadata (line 32, citedOrder 23)
decisions.quote: Thus, our study filled these gaps by replicating and expanding on prior studies (Dixit et al., 2023; He et al., 2020) in a large sample of Chinese general adults.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this work. Xu et al. (2024) recruited 600 Chinese general adults and conducted latent class analysis (LCA) to empirically re-test whether the four latent patterns of negative emotional eating (non-EE, EOE-EUE, EOE, and EUE) and their class differences identified in American and Chinese university students (Dixit et al., 2023; He et al., 2020) replicate in a general adult population, explicitly stating in both the introduction and conclusion previews that the study replicated and extended both Dixit et al. (2023) and He et al. (2020). Furthermore, Dixit et al. (2023) is the closer study in the replication chain that specifically proposed the future directions tested here (replicating the four patterns in a general, non-student population and examining emotion regulation differences across classes). The sole shipped row (1518, He et al., 2020, 10.1016/j.appet.2020.104808) represents only the 2020 Chinese university student study (citedOrder 30), whereas Dixit et al. (2023) (Appetite, 186, 106554, citedOrder 23) is an independent empirical article in an American university sample and is absent from the shipped rows. No DOI is printed for Dixit et al. (2023) in the supplied source text.
